name: dudo-core
description: Dudo-Core — deployment tooling for the Cloudflare Worker. See wrangler.jsonc.

scripts.//migrations: LOCAL variants act on the local simulated D1 and are safe to run freely. REMOTE variants act on the deployed database and are a production-class action requiring explicit user approval each time (.claude/rules/security.md §7). They are separate scripts, and named, so neither can be run by accident.
scripts.//deploy: There is no `deploy` script, deliberately. Deployment is gated on C5 and on explicit user approval; a one-word npm script is exactly the wrong affordance for an action that needs a decision.
